node.title: A full-petal chart injects into its touched-petal index sets
node.statement: In a fixed retained-zero G1 chart, every listed full-petal image has touched modulus degree at least a=ell+d-r>d-r. CRT therefore makes its touched-petal index set determine the effective polynomial uniquely. The complete per-chart list is at most sum_{t>=ceil(a/ell)} C(m,t); the top-band tail theorem sharpens this to m+1 and proves K4. The remaining aggregate obligation is G1 weighted payment sum_chi(m_chi+1)<=(121/128)n^6.
